result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf are covered, paid-up licences are perpetual and irrevocable, revocation or suspension is limited to a material uncured breach after notice and cure opportunity, and transfers to successors are permitted subject to Section 24. The changes are confined to correcting the deficient scope and revocability language in Section 13.1 and preserve the remaining commercial terms. Drafting is professional, though Section 13.3's phrase "during a material uncured...breach" is slightly awkward and its general revocation exception could be read as creating tension with the irrevocability of paid-up licences in Section 13.2.
